dedupe_keys.name: disconnect between capture areas and stormwater runoff a pre and post installation model of two stormwater control measures

description: Disconnect Between Capture Areas and Stormwater Runoff: A Pre- and Post-Installation Model of Two Stormwater Control Measures is a data set listed in HydroShare, an online repository for hydrology data and models, published or maintained by Kirker, Ashleigh (deposited on HydroShare). These are the data used in the paper by Kirker, A N, E Cushman, and L Toran. 2024. We used a combination of overland flow monitoring and distributed hydrologic modeling with GSSHA to evaluate the impacts of Stormwater Control Measures (SCMs) in an 23-ha urban catchment. Coverage: not restricted to one place in the metadata. The resource was created 2023-11-02 and last updated 2024-03-27; HydroShare lists it as a composite resource. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the HydroShare metadata only, so the files and any paper they support were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the abstract may lag the deposit. It can support infrastructure planning, operations and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hydroshare-infrastructure-resources.
